arguments.assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2027 GAAP diluted-EPS/P-E sensitivity, not consensus, forecast, observed multiple, or fair-value estimate. FY27 H1 reported GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP GM +/-50bp, $9.2bn GAAP opex and 16-18% FY tax. Bear $9.50 assumes Q3 is near the low guidance/margin band and Q4 demand or mix normalizes; base $10.10 assumes Q3 guidance is achieved and Q4 sustains broadly Q3-level earnings; bull $10.70 assumes high-end Q3 and continued demand/margin resilience in Q4. Multiples 19x/22x/25x are deliberately unweighted stress assumptions.

cases.rationale: Q3 near low-end guidance/margin and Q4 demand/mix normalization; multiple compression stress.
Q3 guidance achievement and Q4 broadly sustains the earnings run-rate; held as a hypothetical multiple.
High-end Q3 execution plus continued AI infrastructure demand and margin resilience; multiple expansion stress.
